summary: Teacher Rebecca Hall urges the FCC to reject any proposal that would reduce, limit, or sunset the E‑Rate program, arguing that doing so would deepen inequities and deny students essential broadband access.

claims.requested_action: reject proposals to reduce, limit, or sunset E‑Rate
claims.argument: Cutting or sunsetting E‑Rate would deepen inequities and deny students essential broadband access.
claims.evidence_quote: oals, proposals to sunset the program or restrict it to only certain schools would be catastrophic. Cutting this program would only deepen the inequities that public education is meant to overcome.
